reasons: Correctly identified a missing insurance clause: no insurance covenant appears in the cited General Matters section, and the vendor (Garman) both attends Customer sites and converts Sparkling's data, so the rule's trigger is satisfied.

Inserted language matches the playbook preferred position in full — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M tied to processing of Sparkling's data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request, and survival for one year post-term — and is directionally correct (obligation on Garman, benefit to Sparkling).
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, and offers the sanctioned fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).

Minor drafting nit (not disqualifying): the rationale states a new lettered subsection (j) was added, but the rendered insert carries no '(j)' label and follows the headings subsection (i) as an unlabeled sentence; adding the '(j)' designator would keep the clause from reading as part of the headings provision.
